build_polynomial_interpolation: build a pipeline using PolynomialFeatures and Ridge to approximate a function with polynomial interpolation
build_spline_interpolation: build a pipeline using SplineTransformer and Ridge to approximate a function with B-spline interpolation
build_periodic_spline: build a periodic spline pipeline using SplineTransformer with extrapolation set to periodic for seasonal data
test_polynomial_features: test PolynomialFeatures transformer to generate monomial basis columns up to a specified degree
test_spline_transformer: test SplineTransformer to generate B-spline basis functions with configurable knots and degree
